column1: # ViDub pronunciation lexicon example: one 'written<TAB>spoken' row per line.
# Applied to the TTS text only; subtitles keep the written form; extend per video.
# Use it for acronyms and brand names the engine reads wrong (VRAM letter-by-letter,
# ChatGPT spelled out, ...). Blank lines and '#' comments are ignored.
# Longer written forms win over shorter prefixes (e.g. 'ChatGPT' before 'GPT').
